baseline.conditions: Forest-margin road via fixed ridge farms.

title: Where the fields begin to lean
daily_life: Willowmere sends seeds, teaching materials and orchard produce toward Latchford. Fixed ridge farms supply a landscape of inhabited margins, not empty wilderness.
timing: The forest-margin road is a fixed approach to Willowmere. Moving-crown navigation belongs to the next route and cannot begin wherever an exciting root bridge would look best.
handoff: At Willowmere, visitors exchange the road timetable for a guide’s dated canopy briefing. Payment for a guide does not buy the right to overrule a closure.
story_option: A crate of viable seed must arrive in shade while a merchant wants it displayed in the sun for customers. The transport problem becomes visible through living cargo.
production: Let sounds change from wheels and open wind to insects and leaf cover. Carry the same crate dimensions and ventilation marks into the arrival set.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
